verdicts.reason: Both drop the praying-hands photo, the original's key image, and turn the design into a white strip with tiny centred quote text. In both, the 'MAHATMA GANDHI' attribution is crammed against 'BOLT OF THE EVENING' at an illegible size, and the cloud and cross fragments float off to the sides at random. A is worse because of a stray black rectangle clipped at the top edge above the headline, which reads as a broken leftover of the photo; B is cleaner but still nowhere near shippable.
